name: Character sheet, cheap model
prompt: A single character reference sheet on a plain cream background, laid out in three rows. Top row: the same character in front view, side view, three-quarter view and back view, standing neutral. Middle row: five head-only expressions: calm, curious, surprised, worried, stern. Bottom row: five full-body poses: walking, pointing, holding a lantern, crouching, shrugging. Drawing style: a simple hand-drawn character with thick uniform black outlines, a round pale face, small dark eyes, a long dark Victorian coat and a flat cap, thin arms, drawn in flat muted colours with no shading or gradients in a clean 2D animation style. The same character in every panel, identical proportions and colours throughout. No text, no labels, no watermark, no extra limbs, no other characters.
pass: three rows as asked; one consistent character; no text; no extra limbs. This is the cheap sanity check of the API path (1 credit).

name: Character sheet, quality model
prompt: A single character reference sheet on a plain cream background, laid out in three rows. Top row: the same character in front view, side view, three-quarter view and back view, standing neutral. Middle row: five head-only expressions: calm, curious, surprised, worried, stern. Bottom row: five full-body poses: walking, pointing, holding a lantern, crouching, shrugging. Drawing style: a simple hand-drawn character with thick uniform black outlines, a round pale face, small dark eyes, a long dark Victorian coat and a flat cap, thin arms, drawn in flat muted colours with no shading or gradients in a clean 2D animation style. The same character in every panel, identical proportions and colours throughout. No text, no labels, no watermark, no extra limbs, no other characters.
pass: same as I1-01 but clean enough to lock as the channel's character. Compare against I1-01 to decide the default sheet model.

name: World: a place in the same style
prompt: A hand-drawn background illustration of a narrow 1890s London alley at night, gas lamp glow, wet cobblestones, brick walls, a closed wooden door, fog. Simple flat 2D animation style with thick uniform black outlines and flat muted colours, no shading or gradients. No people, no text, no signage, no watermark.
pass: reads as the same drawing style as the sheet; empty of people; usable as a world reference.

name: Item on a plain background
prompt: A single brass hand lantern with a glass panel and a curved handle, centred on a plain cream background, drawn in a simple flat 2D animation style with thick uniform black outlines and flat colours, no shading or gradients. Nothing else in the frame. No text, no watermark.
pass: one clear object, plain background, same line style; usable as an item reference.

name: Thumbnail with empty space for a headline
prompt: A bold high-contrast illustration of the detective character (thick black outlines, round pale face, long dark Victorian coat, flat cap, flat muted colours, 2D animation style) shown from the chest up with a shocked expression, holding up a lantern, against a deep red background. The upper third of the image is empty flat colour reserved for a headline. No text anywhere in the image, no watermark.
pass: upper third genuinely empty; face readable at phone size; no text baked in.

name: Character ref -> new pose and place
prompt: Keep this exact character: same face, coat, cap, proportions, line style and colours. Show him crouched in a foggy 1890s London alley at night, looking over his shoulder toward the viewer, one hand on the wet cobblestones. Flat 2D animation style, no text, no other characters.
pass: clearly the same character as the sheet; new pose and place; style unchanged. If the API ignores the reference, this is the test that says so: run the same through the website (blotato-web skill) and compare.

name: Character ref -> second scene (drift check)
prompt: Keep this exact character: same face, coat, cap, proportions, line style and colours. Show him standing in a dim courthouse corridor, pointing at a closed door, worried expression. Flat 2D animation style, no text, no other characters.
pass: put I2-01 and I2-02 side by side: same person. Note anything that drifted (hat shape, coat colour, face).

name: World ref -> new subject in the same world
prompt: Keep the exact drawing style, palette, lighting and era of this image. Show a different place in the same world: the inside of a cramped 1890s police station office with a wooden desk, an oil lamp and a wall of paper notices. No people, no readable text, no watermark.
pass: new place, same look. Palette and line weight match the alley.

name: Item ref -> item in a new place
prompt: Keep this exact lantern: same shape, handle, glass panel and colours. Place it lit on a wooden table in a dark 1890s room, warm light spilling onto the table. Same flat 2D animation style. No text, no people.
pass: the lantern is recognisably the same object. Small colour drift is acceptable; a different lantern is a fail.

name: Mix: character + world (2 refs)
prompt: Put this exact character (first image) into this exact place (second image): he walks down the alley toward the viewer holding a lantern, fog around his boots. Keep both the character's design and the alley's style, palette and lighting unchanged. No text, no other characters.
pass: both held. If the API only accepts one image, the second ref is dropped; note that and run this one on the website instead.

name: Your own picture as the reference
prompt: Keep this exact character: same design, proportions, line style and colours. Show it sitting on a park bench at dusk, looking up at the sky. No text, no other characters.
pass: Drew drops any drawing or photo into tests/generation/images/own/ and renames it in cases.json. The upload works (a public URL comes back) and the character survives the edit.
